reflection: Parallel identity and season ambiguity remain the largest reusable recognition gaps.
Serial numbering errors increased and should be separated into OCR misses versus checklist misses.
Waiting for all 100 predictions before source-assisted labeling wastes wall-clock time without improving blind-test integrity.
Incremental labeling is safe only when current-batch labels are excluded from every prediction job in that batch.

reflection: v4.9 did not generalize: Top-1 and Top-3 fell to 36.08% and 37.11% on a zero-overlap batch.
Parallel errors were dominated by taxonomy pollution: product logos and finish words were stored as parallel names instead of canonical colors.
Machine truth itself used inconsistent full-finish versus color-only parallel names, invalidating earlier cross-batch comparisons.
Strict season and exact-card identity remain major unsolved errors; no unvalidated retrieval heuristic was promoted.
Long collection requests exposed retry idempotency and concurrent top-up races.
